'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***A [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[drone attack]] on [[Kyiv]] injures at least two [[civilian]]s and damages infrastructure. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-66184558 (BBC News)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Battle of Geneina]]
***The [[United Nations]] reports the discovery of a [[mass grave]] in the area of [[Geneina]], [[West Darfur]], [[Sudan]], believed to contain at least 87 individuals, including women and children, reportedly killed by the [[Rapid Support Forces]] and an affiliated [[Sudanese Arabs|Arab]] militia. [https://apnews.com/article/west-darfur-mass-grave-sudan-un-0e6b29f58c2f80c4ecf9ff24cb869cdc (AP)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**Four people are killed in [[Jubaland]], [[Somalia]], after [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|al-Shabaab]] is confirmed to have captured a [[military base]] in the area which had been handed to Somalia by the [[military of Kenya|Kenyan military]] on June 29. [https://english.news.cn/20230714/a17d9a6544934d42b1aa95b585c22ab8/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[2023 Hollywood labor disputes]]
**[[2023 SAG-AFTRA strike]], [[2023 Writers Guild of America strike]]
***The members of [[SAG-AFTRA]] announce that they will join the writers on a strike following failed negotiations with the [[Alliance of Motion Picture and Television Producers]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/amp/2023/07/13/sag-actors-union-goes-on-strike-joining-hollywood-writers.html (CNBC)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*After heavy rainfall in [[Delhi]], [[India]], the [[Yamuna]] reaches record-high water levels, resulting in [[flood]] warnings and [[Emergency evacuation|evacuations]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2023/07/12/Indian-capital-New-Delhi-on-alert-for-floods-after-river-level-hits-all-time-high (Bloomberg via Al-Arabiya)] [https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/yamuna-water-level-delhi-flood-arvind-kejriwal-yamuna-level-in-delhi-rises-further-flooding-near-arvind-kejriwals-home-4202482 (NDTV)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Birth control in the United States]]
**The [[Food and Drug Administration]] approves the first [[Over-the-counter drug|over-the-counter]] [[contraceptive pill]], the [[Perrigo]]-manufactured [[Norgestrel|Opill]], broadening access to [[birth control]] across the country. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230713-first-no-prescription-birth-control-pill-approved-in-us (AFP via France 24)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Marshall Islands–United States relations]]
**[[Nuclear testing at Bikini Atoll]], [[Pacific Proving Grounds]]
***The [[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Marshall Islands)|foreign ministry]] of the [[Marshall Islands]] calls for more [[United States]] compensation over [[nuclear weapons testing]], including on [[Bikini Atoll]], in an effort to improve bilateral relations. [https://www.reuters.com/world/marshall-islands-seek-more-us-nuclear-legacy-funds-settle-strategic-deal-2023-07-13/ (Reuters)]
*[[Colombia–Nicaragua relations]], [[Territorial disputes of Nicaragua]]
**The [[International Court of Justice]] dismisses [[Nicaragua]]'s bid to extend its [[maritime territory]] beyond 200 [[nautical mile]]s, upholding the allocation of seven [[Caribbean islands]] to [[Colombia]] in a 2012 ruling. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/international-news/20230713-un-court-rejects-nicaragua-claims-in-colombia-sea-row (AFP via RFI)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Jacob Zuma corruption charges]]
**The [[Constitutional Court of South Africa]] dismisses former [[President of South Africa|president]] [[Jacob Zuma]]'s appeal to legalize his [[medical parole]] and ruling he must complete his 15-month prison sentence for [[contempt of court]]. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2023/07/14/safricas-zuma-in-russia-for-health-reasons-spokesman-a81847 (AFP via ''The Moscow Times'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*Aftermath of the [[2023 Guatemalan general election]]
**The Guatemalan Public Ministry seizes information related to the [[Semilla (political party)|Movimiento Semilla]] party at the offices of the [[Supreme Electoral Tribunal (Guatemala)|Supreme Electoral Tribunal]] in [[Guatemala City]]. The tribunal announces that it will legally appeal the resolution that ordered the suspension of the party's registration, claiming that the resolution is unconstitutional. [https://www.prensalibre.com/guatemala/elecciones-generales-guatemala-2023/presidenta-del-tse-habla-sobre-la-orden-de-suspender-la-personalidad-juridica-del-movimiento-semilla-y-dice-que-lo-tiene-que-resolver-el-registro-breaking/ (''Prensa Libre'')] [https://www.prensalibre.com/guatemala/elecciones-generales-guatemala-2023/en-vivo-tse-oficializa-resultados-electorales-mientras-juzgado-suspende-personalidad-juridica-de-movimiento-semilla-feci-ministerio-publico/ (''Prensa Libre'' 2)]
**The Semilla party files an appeal before the [[Constitutional Court of Guatemala|Constitutional Court]]. The Court accepts the appeal, allowing the party to participate in the second round of the election on August 20. However, according to the criteria of jurists, the legal recourse granted is ambiguous. [https://www.prensalibre.com/ahora/guatemala/elecciones-generales-guatemala-2023/cc-emite-amparo-provisional-a-favor-del-partido-semilla/ (''Prensa Libre'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[2024 Summer Olympics]], [[Non-government reactions to the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**The [[International Olympic Committee]] says that athletes from [[Russia]] and [[Belarus]] will not receive invitations to the [[Summer Olympic Games]] in [[Paris]], [[France]], and will only be able to compete as neutral athletes. [https://thehill.com/policy/international/4095733-russia-belarus-not-invited-to-paris-olympics-ioc/amp/ (''The Hill'')]
